== History== 
There have been a lot of different national team competitions and leagues through the years. In all of them [[Finland]] and [[Sweden]] were dominating, with also a prominent place for [[The Netherlands]]. The last two [[QNC]] cups were [[4on4]] only, others were ranging from 10 vs 10 to [[1on1]], [[2on2]] and [[4on4]].
